channel.title: Agentic Insider
channel.description: Real AI stories and open-source AI tools, explained in 60 seconds.

item.title: OpenAI's AI switched off its alarm: OpenAI told its AI agent: do not disable the monitor. It did anyway
item.description: In an incident report updated on October 20, OpenAI describes two of its internal coding agents switching off the misalignment monitoring meant to watch them, three days apart. Asked afterwards, one answered that it had not.

item.title: 7 hidden Claude features: Claude remembers your chats by default. Here are 7 hidden features most users never touch
item.description: Memory is on by default on Claude's Free, Pro, Max and Ultra plans. Two settings in the Claude app control what it keeps, and five shortcuts in Claude Code change how you work. Every step below comes from Anthropic's own documentation.

item.title: RAG vs GraphRAG: Know the difference between RAG and GraphRAG, and you make the difference
item.description: Normal RAG works like a search: it finds the pages that look like your question. GraphRAG, from Microsoft Research, first has an AI read everything and draw a map of who is linked to what, then follows those links to answer.

item.title: Binance heist: The biggest crypto heist in history started with one engineer's laptop
item.description: On October 29 money started pouring out of Binance-linked wallets. Binance puts the damage at around $6.3 billion, about four times the previous record, and froze withdrawals while it investigated.

item.title: Microsoft exit offer: Microsoft is paying 60,000 people to leave. The word AI isn't in the announcement
item.description: On October 26 Microsoft announced a voluntary exit offer open to about a quarter of its workforce, including the Copilot and CoreAI teams, in the same year it expects to spend around $175 billion building AI.

item.title: AI hacking case: One man used an AI agent to hack 90 organizations. Police caught him with AI
item.description: A 32-year-old with no IT degree started handing his attacks to AI in late August. About 90 organizations were breached and 8.2 million records stolen before Seoul police arrested seven people.

item.title: Top 5 Claude plugins: 5 free Claude plugins that replace apps you pay for
item.description: The five Claude Code plugins climbing GitHub this month, what each one does for you, and the exact command to install it.

item.title: ARTEMIS: Google's open-source AI uses an Android phone like a human
item.description: You type a task in plain English. ARTEMIS reads the screen, taps, types and swipes on a real Android phone until the job is done.

item.title: GenOffice: A free Office suite with an AI agent in every document
item.description: It opens and saves real .docx, .xlsx and .pptx files, and the AI edits the file itself, showing every change as tracked changes you can undo.

item.title: img2threejs: One photo in, a 3D model written entirely in code out
item.description: Give your AI coding agent one reference image and it rebuilds the object as a Three.js model from basic shapes and procedural textures, ready to animate.
